description: Release gate for a church-authorized live pilot. Netlify build success and fixture demos do not satisfy these requirements.

gates.label: Leadership approves pilot use, cohort, campus, age bounds and accountable owner
Real sign-in, server-side session and context-scoped leader permissions tested
Church approves sources, scopes, consent, data retention, privacy and tenant isolation
Verify least-privilege group membership and personal schedule source with authorized test users
Choose approved chat link-out or secure real messaging; minor safeguarding and abuse controls validated
Attendance data entry and human pastoral follow-up policy signed off; no inferred risk scoring
Reading permissions, Bible text rights, review and publishing hierarchy approved
Security review, incident/support owner, audit logs, backups, retention and rollback approved
Cross-device, performance, accessibility, mobile UI and automated regression suite passed
Authorized real-user dry run and go/no-go approval completed
